descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
You are a cat. Your hands are your front paws.

RUN ON YOUR PAWS
Push the floor with your paws to run, let go mid-stroke to fling yourself across the room, jump onto sofas and counters, and climb the bookcases and curtains. The left stick walks too, for comfort.

FERAL TAG
One cat goes feral. One touch of a feral paw and you go wild too. Hiss to stun a feral and get away - the last cats standing win, or the ferals take the whole house.

MISCHIEF
Team up and wreck Granny's house. Cups, vases, books, plates, bottles and plants sit on every table, counter and shelf on both floors. Knock them to the floor and fill the chaos meter before time runs out.

GRANNY
She hears every crash, stomps over with her broom and talks the whole time. Get up high - she can't reach you on the shelves.

PLAY ONLINE OR WITH BOTS
Quick Match with players around the world, make a private room with a 4-digit code for friends, or play with bots any time. Empty seats fill with bots, so a game always starts. Up to 8 cats in a room.

NINE CATS
Ginger, silver tabby, black, snow white, tuxedo, calico, Russian blue, brown tabby and a Sphynx. Earn fish coins for tags, crashes and wins.

Thirteen rooms in bright colours upstairs and down. Mute, block and report players at any time. Voice chat is off until you turn it on. Music on/off with volume, sound effects volume. English.
